name: The Rev. Kathy Ayres
title: Deacon
shortBio: Serving in compassion and accessibility ministry
fullBio: Kathy Ayres grew up in a strong Christian family and has been actively volunteering in ministry since her teen years. After a 35-year career in Occupational Therapy, Kathy sensed a call to ministry with people affected by disabilities. She is pursuing a Master of Arts in Religion with a focus on Catechesis & Christian Formation at Trinity Anglican Seminary. Kathy has a passion to help churches become more accessible, creating communities of belonging for growth and service for individuals with and without disabilities.
family: Married to Bob with six adult children through adoption (two of whom are Deaf) and a dozen delightful grandchildren
